clues.narrowing: rules out everything outside central Burkina Faso, north of the capital

clues.text: Though the land around is arid and dry, the lake lets people farm its shore all year round.
clues.narrowing: rules out dry Sahel towns with no lake to farm beside all year

source.quote: The lake, Lac du Bam is part of the upper reaches of the southward-flowing Volta system, and its presence permits year-round lakeshore cultivation in an otherwise arid climate.
